label: AlphaFold 2's structure module versus AlphaFold 3's diffusion module
context: Two panels (stacked on narrow widths). Left 'AF2: structure module': 10 residues drawn as small triangles (rigid frames) all starting at the origin with identical orientation ('black hole' initialisation); over 8 iterations labelled 'IPA block 1 … 8' the frames move and rotate into a folded chain in one deterministic pass; side chains appear as torsion angles at the end (small sticks). Caption 'one deterministic prediction, frames + torsions, equivariant attention (IPA)'. Right 'AF3: diffusion module': ~40 atoms as dots start as a wide Gaussian cloud; over 'denoising steps' they condense into the all-atom structure; show three different noise seeds giving three slightly different final structures overlaid in different blues. Caption 'all atoms directly, a generative model: different noise → different samples; no frames, no torsions, no equivariance'. Canvas is responsive: width anywhere from 340 to 900 px, height 400 px; derive every size and position from width and height, keep all text at least 11 px and fully inside the canvas, and on narrow widths stack or shrink rather than overlap. Loop forever on a cycle of 10 to 16 s with smooth easing between phases. White background. Put a one-line phase caption at the top centre that changes with the phase. No title inside the canvas (the card has one). Use plain sans-serif labels.

spec.title: AF2 structure module vs AF3 diffusion module
spec.caption: Left: AlphaFold 2 starts with every residue frame at the origin. Eight IPA blocks move and rotate the frames into one deterministic fold, then torsion angles add side chains. Right: AlphaFold 3 starts all atoms as a Gaussian cloud and denoises them directly. Three noise seeds give three slightly different structures.
